title: Six slides on magnetic dipoles and magnetic vehicle parameters
description: Page of six reproduced presentation slides with technical figures: "Magnetic dipole" (current loop with field lines), "Magnetic field for a dipole" (log-log field vs. distance curves), "Variation with latitude" (field and angle curves vs. latitude), "Earth force on magnetic dipole," "Moment, field, size relations" (log-log plot with a marked useful region), and "Magnetic vehicle parameters" (log-log chart with a "Design note" callout). Axis labels and annotations are small and partly illegible. The footer reads "Page 5 of 5," "BAASS CONFIDENTIAL" (struck through) and "Nov-08."
